goal: BENCHMARK, design only. Judged against 'reference' (a pipeline published by Comfy-Org or the model vendor): the agent's stages must reach the same result with free models - the same kind of steps in the same order, each fed by the right earlier output, prompts that describe exactly what was asked, and a design that holds with every ? answered. Nothing is installed or run.

reference.source: Lightricks official LTX-2.5_T2V_I2V_Two_Stage_Distilled.json (github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo example_workflows/2.5; README: two-stage is 'Start here')
must: an audio-video model (sound generated with the picture)
the two-stage (upscale + refine) route, or an upscale stage after
10 s at the model's frame grid
prompt describes the sound as well as the picture

turns.text: Make a 10-second clip with sound of a fox walking through a snowy forest at dawn, with lots of fine detail.
